citation: L. T. E. Stubbington, Durham University doctoral thesis (2018), section 3.3.3, Fig. 3.6, printed p. 36
observable: Normalized mean fluorescein intensity at one confocal focal plane in the same PDMS chamber after equilibration. A pipette withdraws part of the volume and refills it with water.
uncertainty: Centers read from the figure to about 0.01. Bars are SEM across three repeat measurements, approximately 0.11 at wash 1 and 0.06 at wash 5. The last measured marker is at wash 9. At wash 10 only the reference line is plotted.
scope: Section 3.3.3 defines the fraction as the volume removed. The plotted reference follows (1 - 0.2)^n. The printed exponential in Eq. 3.7 has the opposite trend at f = 0.2. The author discusses possible fluorescence nonlinearity at late washes. The withdrawal and total chamber tracer mass were unassayed.
